prompt: Stage 3-3, level 6, 41 gold. The shop shows a 3-cost caster for 3 gold. It would be a small upgrade on the 1-star 1-cost caster on your board, but it is not a copy of anything you own and not a trait you are building. Buy or hold?

options.label: Hold: buying drops you under 40 and costs 1 gold of interest every round until you climb back over it
Buy: 3 gold is nothing and any upgrade is worth it
Buy it and refresh for a second copy so the 3-cost becomes a pair

explanation:
You are 1 gold over the 40 line. Buying drops you to 38 (39 after selling the old caster): 3 interest instead of 4, every round, until you are back over 40. Holding instead, next round pays 5 + 4 = 9 and you sit at 50, the cap, a round or two earlier. The upgrade on offer is a 1-star 3-cost you have no plan for.

'3 gold is nothing' ignores the rounding: the same buy from 45 would cost no interest at all. Spend the last gold above a 10 only for a copy that makes a 2-star or a unit that reaches a breakpoint.
principle: Before spending, check whether the buy crosses a 10. If it does, the unit had better be worth a gold a round.
commonMistake: Buying marginal units from 41 or 51 and never noticing that the interest line moved.
hint: Look at the tens digit of your gold before and after the purchase, and at what you earn next round in each case.
